_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Surface calm masks demand gap and positioning extremes, so base case is grind lower or chop inside Anxiety until flows or F&G confirm.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit DOWN/Anxiety low-conviction; narrative silent on forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G breaks under 40, 30d decline extends, funding flat-to-negative, ETF flows stay near 0
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound well off 1 and F&G lifts through 60 with options skew normalizing
